```sql
WITH ProductOrderLines AS (
    SELECT 
        oi.product_id,
        COUNT(o.order_id) AS total_order_lines
    FROM 
        orders o
    JOIN 
        order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
    WHERE 
        o.status = 'completed'
    GROUP BY 
        oi.product_id
),
EligibleProducts AS (
    SELECT 
        product_id
    FROM 
        ProductOrderLines
    WHERE 
        total_order_lines >= 50
),
ReturnedOrderLines AS (
    SELECT 
        oi.product_id,
        COUNT(*) AS returned_order_lines
    FROM 
        orders o
    JOIN 
        order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
    WHERE 
        o.status = 'returned'
        AND oi.product_id IN (SELECT product_id FROM EligibleProducts)
    GROUP BY 
        oi.product_id
)
SELECT 
    p.name,
    (r.returned_order_lines * 100.0 / pol.total_order_lines) AS return_rate
FROM 
    products p
JOIN 
    EligibleProducts ep ON p.product_id = ep.product_id
JOIN 
    ReturnedOrderLines r ON p.product_id = r.product_id
JOIN 
    ProductOrderLines pol ON p.product_id = pol.product_id
ORDER BY 
    return_rate DESC
LIMIT 1;
```
